Servers, ports, security and user names
These are filled in for UPM accounts. Change them only if you need to. While you leave a server unchanged, its user name is detected automatically when you sign in.
Enter a server name, such as correo.upm.es
Without encryption, your password and messages travel in plain text. Use it only on networks you trust.

Use your UPM user name and password, the same ones you use for the UPM webmail and intranet. If you changed your password recently, use the new one.
Check that your phone\'s date and time are correct. Some public Wi-Fi networks also interfere with secure connections; try another network.
Check that you\'re connected to the Internet. Some networks block mail connections; try another Wi-Fi network or mobile data.
The UPM mail service may be temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
